yieldKgPerTreeMature.notes: CONVERTED, arithmetic shown: took the 'Average' yield band (15-18 t/ha) and the same source's stated spacing ('Generally planted 6m x 4m or 5 m x 3 m'). At 6x4m = 24 m²/tree → 10000/24 = 416.7 trees/ha → 15000kg/416.7=36.0 and 18000kg/416.7=43.2 kg/tree. At 5x3m = 15 m²/tree → 666.7 trees/ha → 15000/666.7=22.5 and 18000/666.7=27.0 kg/tree. Combined range across both spacings, rounded: [23, 43] kg/tree. This spread reflects the two different sourced spacings, not cultivar variation.

evidence.quote:
Low chill areas (200-600PCU’s) 
Peaches – Transvalia, Sonette, Oom Sarel, Keisie
evidence.doc: KwaZulu-Natal Department of Agriculture and Rural Development, 'Fruit and Nut Production in KZN' (Horticultural Advisory Notes)

chillUnits.notes: PCU = Peach Chill Units (Infruitec/ARC chill-unit model used for SA stone fruit). This source's 'low chill' band (200-600 PCU) is corroborated by per-cultivar Culdevco/ARC sheets: 'Earligold' = 'low to medium (200-400 Infruitec Chilling Units)'; 'Cederberg' and 'Afrisun' = 'Medium (400-600 Infruitec Chilling Units)'. The KZN source's own category label bundles both 'low' and 'medium' ARC sub-bands into one 'low chill areas' bracket contrasted with '>600 PCU's' for high-chill areas.

evidence.quote: ‘Self’ – This cultivar is self-fertile and does not require a separate pollinator variety.
evidence.doc: Culdevco — Earligold peach cultivar information sheet

pollination.notes: Corroborated by the Cederberg sheet ('Self' pollinating) and the Afrisun sheet ('Pollinator: Self-compatible'), all three being ARC Infruitec-Nietvoorbij low/medium-chill peach cultivars.

gaps: Yield-per-tree figure required combining a t/ha range with a separately-sourced spacing figure from the same KZN document (see notes) — treat as an approximate, arithmetic-derived range rather than a directly-stated per-tree figure.

No single, comprehensive harvest-month range found for 'low-chill peach' as a category; the months given are from three specific ARC-bred low/medium-chill cultivars (Earligold, Cederberg, Afrisun) rather than a stated season for the category as a whole. Harvest weeks for the KZN-named low-chill cultivars themselves (Transvalia, Sonette, Oom Sarel, Keisie) were only partly found (Transvalia ~Week 47/3rd week November, from an unquoted search summary of a Culdevco Red Velvet page, not independently verified with a direct fetch) and are not included as sourced evidence.

DALRRD/nda.gov.za stone-fruit production guidelines and Hortgro Science's own production manuals were not directly fetchable in full (gov.za domains blocked/503; Hortgro-Science cultivar app pages returned post-harvest handling data, not chill/pollination/yield).

'Years to full bearing' and 'years to first crop' were sourced from a general KZN peach section, not specifically restricted to low-chill cultivars, though the source's low-chill cultivar list (Transvalia, Sonette, Oom Sarel, Keisie) appears in the same document section.
